title: About Me
text:
Hi, I’m Yuhe Tian. I earned my bachelor’s degree in Finance from the University of International Business and Economics and am currently pursuing a master’s degree in Applied Economics and Data Science at the University of Pennsylvania.
My academic interests include finance, econometrics, and economics. I have a basic working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Python, Stata, EViews, and SPSS. After graduation, I hope to pursue a career in investment banking.
